title: Scales
text:
I suppose a great app for those who are OCD scale users (used to be me) but a standing naked in front of a mirror, “listening” to your body and sticking to your plan is far more useful than an app or a scale.

Ditch the scale and the app, start moving in ways that are meaningful, eat well, and pay attention to how you look and feel.  That is best feedback you can have.

title: Stopped Working
text: I loved this app, it was great… then it just stopped syncing with my other apps. So even though my other apps had recorded my weight and this app had been syncing for months, now it’s just not doing that. I went in and searched for fixes. I reset the sync settings a few times and that worked for a day or two and pretty soon it just stopped again. Incredibly frustrating, I found this very helpful when it had the data that all my other health apps have. I’m not manually entering my weight everyday and I’m not troubleshooting the sync settings every day either. So I’m deleting this app and hope I’ll find something similar one day that actually works.

title: Love some things don’t love others.
text:
I’ve used Happy Scale for years and genuinely love the layout, simplicity, and long-term tracking it offers. It’s been one of the most helpful tools in my wellness journey.

That said, the recent addition of the BMI tracker dropped this to a 2-star experience for me. Unlike the other features, there’s no option to toggle it off, and it’s placed right in the middle of the dashboard. For those of us who find BMI irrelevant or even triggering, it’s frustrating to have it front and center with no way to hide or move it.

I really wish this feature followed the same customizable setup as the rest of the app. Until that’s fixed, it makes the daily experience feel less supportive—and that’s a shame for an app that’s otherwise been a great companion.

title: Maybe I Don’t Get It
text: I was searching for a free body measurement app and this was high on the suggestion list and had rave reviews. It’s not free; the subscription $12-$24 a year depending on your payment schedule and the only measurement it takes is weight and height. It’s the only thing this does for $24. My interface doesn’t even look anything like the App store screenshots. I don’t get the appeal. I’m going to give it two more days and then cancelling. Free weight loss apps are dime a dozen and usually have more features.

title: DON’T DO IT - LOST EVERYTHING AFTER YEARS
text: I’ve been using happy scale since 2021 for weight management, great app, I love it. Went to open it up today, absolutely NOTHING is there. The app is asking me to create a profile or ‘sync’ but nothing comes up with syncing. Literal years of weight tracking just down the drain AND I’ve been paying. There is no customer support option so I’m just out of luck.  I thought this app was superior to MyFitnessPal, you might as well just stick with MyFitness free to track weight because atleast your data will save. I will be happy to change my review after my account information is restored or my YEARS of paying for premium are refunded. Absolutely disgusting guys.

title: Prediction not working
text: I have used this app for years and it has always been excellent! Except I recently changed my goal weight and now the predictions are totally off. I have a relatively high weight loss goal per week of 2.5 pounds and it saying I’m going to lose 18 pounds in 30 days… but that should be a little over 10 pounds. I have tried changing all the numbers, as low as 1 pound a week and also putting in my old goal weight, but all of the predictions still come out wrong. The prediction tracker is one of the best parts of the app, so it’s really disappointing that it’s not working for some reason. I have updated the app and it’s still not working. I thought maybe if I upgraded to the paid version it would work but I’m afraid it won’t and don’t want to waste money.

title: Accessibility?
text: I am a new user of this app and love its simple easy to use design. The only  complaint I have is the lack of accessibility features. I have the text size the biggest it can possibly be on my phone but the text is still way too small on this app. The  widgets should have a larger text option as well. They would be great to use but even with screen magnification it can still be small. Making a bigger text option for the widgets should be  a priority Other than that it's great .

title: Good app but potential to be so much greater
text: This app is just ok for me. I am visually driven therefore I chose this app to help me stay motivated by the visuals of my weight loss. I don’t have much to lose but am aiming for about 10-15lbs. This app checks the box in the aspect of seeing my progress in real time data and I like that but it also has the potential to be so much more. For example if someone has stayed the same weight for a certain amount of time, I think it would be a great tool to have a pop-up type link like “I see you may have hit a plateau in your weight loss journey - that’s ok it happens. Here are some tips/tricks/tools that could help break through that plateau and get you back on track to meeting your goals sooner”. Something along those lines would really help users. I’ve struggled recently with a plateau and just thought the app offering some guidance would really improve my experience.

title: OS feature costs?!?!
text:
Apple Health integration costs?! Might as well be a paid app, not an app with premium add-on features. Also, Apple supposedly doesn't allow charging extra for OS-level features.

I'm all for developers earning a living wage, but such a basic thing in an otherwise free app with premium features feels bait-and-switch.

title: App is completely inaccurate, only reason people give good reviews is because they didn’t test.
text:
I’m clean bulking, aiming to gain .4-.6lb per week
Anyway, I’ve noticed I’ve gained more weight than I wanted too, so I wanted to test the accuracy of this app. On my own I added up this weeks weights taken everyday, and divided it by 7 days. I did the same for the previous week and then I subtracted them. This is the formula for figuring out how much weight u gained per week. Anyway, the app said I lost .2lb but the real calculation I gained .3lbs. DO NOT BUY
